what.text: This page follows refugees from Sudan living in Chad.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1330950 Sudanese refugees in Chad, 47.2% of all Sudanese refugees and more than in any other host country.
South Sudan and Libya host the next largest numbers.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan from 1987 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2025, at war level from 2023.
From 2020 to 2025 the opposing groups include the RSF, the SLM/A, the SPLM/A-North and the SFA.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Chad rose from 70 in 1992 to 1330950 in 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025; earlier big changes in the figure came between 2003 and 2004.
Returns from Chad to Sudan were highest in 2015 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Chad only; Sudanese refugees in other countries are counted on other pages.
Chad's share of all Sudanese refugees fell from 61.7% in 2023 to 47.2% in 2025.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Chad they live.
